title: Religious, Racial, and Ethnic Persecution and Discrimination
text: To provide charitable assistance, support, and advocacy for individuals and communities who face persecution or discrimination based on religion, race, ethnicity, nationality, or national origin, and to help address the consequences of such persecution or discrimination.

title: Humanitarian Assistance and Relief
text: To provide charitable humanitarian assistance and relief to individuals and communities in need through the provision of food, clothing, housing assistance, essential supplies, and emergency assistance.

title: Animal Welfare Assistance
text: To provide charitable financial assistance and support for the care and well-being of animals.

title: Environmental Conservation and Sustainability
text: To conduct and support charitable environmental conservation and sustainability initiatives, including the preservation and restoration of forests, the planting of trees, the protection of natural resources, and environmental improvement initiatives.
